usedFor: ArcSite holds field drawings and proposals, and HubSpot receives them as records through “Create Deal” or “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When an ArcSite event occurs” in ArcSite, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It covers proposal status changes and payments received, so a deal can follow the proposal.

watchOut: “New Project Created” in ArcSite is polling, so “Create Deal” runs after a scheduled check.
